abstract: A 37-year-old woman with the complaint of stomachache was referred to our hospital because a retroperitoneal tumor was detected in an ultrasound study at another hospital. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a poorly enhanced 14 cm tumor in the left retroperitoneal space suggesting a cyst that contained fat and showed calcification. Abdominal dynamic computed tomography revealed left renal vein stenosis and left ovarian vein dilation caused by tumor compression of the renal vein. The tumor was excised together with the left kidney because the renal vein was adhered to the tumor. The resected specimen weighed 1,300 g, and the histological diagnosis was mature teratoma. The patient has experienced no recurrence at eight months after surgery.
abstract_ja: 37歳の女性が腹痛を主訴に来院した。他院の超音波検査で後腹膜腫瘍が発見されたため紹介となった。磁気共鳴画像法では、左後腹膜腔に14cmの造影不良な腫瘤を認め、脂肪成分を含み石灰化を伴う嚢胞性病変が示唆された。腹部ダイナミックコンピュータ断層撮影では、腫瘍による腎静脈圧迫に伴う左腎静脈狭窄と左卵巣静脈の拡張が認められた。腎静脈が腫瘍に癒着していたため、腫瘍を左腎とともに切除した。切除標本の重量は1,300gで、病理組織学的診断は成熟奇形腫であった。術後8か月の時点で再発は認めていない。
